details:
Project Details – Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive educational web application designed to introduce students to astronaut training and space exploration through engaging simulations and missions.

The application provides different training modules, including Gravity Simulator, Microgravity Simulator, Astronaut Fitness, Emergency Training, Environmental Control, and Lunar Landing Simulator. Users can interact with these modules, complete challenges, earn XP points, unlock badges, progress through multiple levels, and track their mission achievements.

The main benefit of this project is that it makes space science more interactive, understandable, and enjoyable. It encourages students to explore astronaut training concepts through practical virtual experiences rather than only theoretical learning.

The intended impact is to inspire young learners to develop an interest in space exploration, science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM).

The project was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Visual design, interactive simulations, and browser-based technologies were used to create an accessible learning experience without requiring additional hardware.

The creative aspect of the project is its combination of astronaut training simulations with game-based learning features such as XP, achievements, badges, and multiple levels.

During development, we considered user-friendliness, simple navigation, engaging design, educational value, accessibility, and the importance of making each mission interesting for young learners.
